title: Impact of US Tariff Increases and US Export Declines on Price Pressures for Singaporeans
what_it_is: Impact of US Tariff Increases and US Export Declines on Price Pressures for Singaporeans

sections.label: US tariffs and Singapore inflation
sections.summary: US tariffs cut non-oil domestic exports to the US, but are not expected to directly affect Singapore inflation.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Trade and Industry (Ms Gan Siow Huang) (for the Minister for Trade and Industry)
sentences.text: Singapore's non-oil domestic exports to the US fell by 9.2% year-on-year from April to December 2025.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Trade and Industry (Ms Gan Siow Huang) (for the Minister for Trade and Industry)
sentences.text: The tariffs and corresponding decline in exports to the US are not expected to have a direct impact on Singapore's inflation.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Trade and Industry (Ms Gan Siow Huang) (for the Minister for Trade and Industry)
sentences.text: This is because the tariffs are paid for by the US importers.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Trade and Industry (Ms Gan Siow Huang) (for the Minister for Trade and Industry)
sentences.text: Nonetheless, there could be an indirect impact if higher prices in the US lead to an increase in the prices of its exports, including to Singapore, in the future.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Trade and Industry (Ms Gan Siow Huang) (for the Minister for Trade and Industry)
sentences.text: Thus far, we have not observed any tariff impact on Singapore's import prices, with our import prices falling in 2025.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Trade and Industry (Ms Gan Siow Huang) (for the Minister for Trade and Industry)
sentences.text: In turn, the decline in import prices helped to lower Consumer Price Index (CPI)-All Items inflation and Monetary Authority of Singapore's Core Inflation to 0.9% and 0.7% respectively last year.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Trade and Industry (Ms Gan Siow Huang) (for the Minister for Trade and Industry)
sentences.text: We will continue to closely monitor our import prices and inflation rates and the corresponding impact on Singaporeans, especially those from lower-income household groups, and we stand ready to provide further support if needed.

sections.label: CPI inflation by income group
sections.summary: Last year CPI-All Items inflation was 0.6% for the lowest 20% income group and 0.9% for the middle 60%.

sentences.speaker: Ms Gan Siow Huang
sentences.text: For example, for the lowest 20% income household groups, we know that last year the CPI-All Items inflation for them was 0.6%.

sentences.speaker: Ms Gan Siow Huang
sentences.text: And this is different from that for the middle 60% income group of 0.9%.
